reviews.author: Michele
reviews.text: These guys really went the extra mile to take care of us. They even drove us down to get a rental car so we could get by. And they’re even fixing our exhaust. Finally, someone capable!!

reviews.author: Erica Nohr
reviews.text: I left a dealership cause I had a sensor that needed to be fixed. Got a half an hour down the road and all the sudden my car was overheating and I look over and I pull into an automotive shop. The shop was so nice they got me in checked it filled My fluids had very kind words very supportive. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: CEELO BLUE
reviews.text: Jennifer Cintron : Best customer service, Always willing to help, and they also take their time on your vehicle. I will recommend Pace Automotive in Lake City Sc to all my family, friends, and co- workers. I am 1 hundred percent satisfied with their work and customer service. (By the way They give their customers snack and drinks).Love the company.

reviews.author: Carsha Nesmith
reviews.text: Very horrible experience. Had my truck for more than 3 weeks and it's still not fixed. I advise anyone to NOT take their vehicle to this place.

reviews.author: Steve Jimenez
reviews.text: These guys here are just terrific. They do good quality work and keep their prices reasonable. They are now my go to shop for my vehicles!

reviews.author: allegra willis
reviews.text: Pace has a welcome atmosphere and great owners. My vehicle is old; however, the mechanics took care of my auto needs to keep it movin.

reviews.author: Jonathon Harrell
reviews.text: Great shop to take your vehicle to whenever it's beyond your capabilities to fix it yourself! The staff is great & their mechanics do great & reliable work!
